lots.guide_summary: All of the 95 to 210 range is SOLD: eight Gowans hammers (premium extra) from Nov 2025 to Sept 2026, record opened for each and seven photos checked. No UNSOLD found. The only ASKING entry kept is PriceCharting's US loose price (about A$109 at 1.4286 per USD), shown for context only. Bundles with at least one controller made $140 to $210; console plus game with no controller made $95; the wheel lot made $110.
lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD for a console with at least one controller and power at Gowans in the last 24 months is $140 hammer (lot 381931, Dec 2025: console, one controller, one game, the closest content match). 140 / 1.198 = 116.86, rounded down to $115 (all-in about $137.77). The no-controller lot ($95) and the wheel lot ($110) are excluded as lesser bundles; if they were counted, keep would be 95 / 1.198 = 79.3, so $75. Flip: likely resale $170 (Gowans hammer for the near-identical Turok-stickered console bundle, lot 414910; no verified eBay sold data). Less eBay AU fees about 13.4% ($22.78) and outbound postage about $25 = $122.22. 122.22 / 2.396 = 51.0, rounded down to $50. A $50 hammer is far below what these make, so flipping is not realistic; KEEP only.
lots.confidence_reason: Clearly an N64 (shape, official Nintendo green controller with logo read), and eight Gowans SOLD results with records opened and seven photos checked. Held back from High because working order, region and the third-party grey controller are unconfirmed, and the sticker wrap lowers appeal.

lots.what_it_is: Framed modern reproduction of John Tallis / J. Rapkin 'Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania' (c.1851 design), printed in a single blue tone (map, vignettes and border all the same blue), in a burr-effect frame with gold slip behind glass. The flat one-colour printing, including the vignettes and medallion, is typical of decorative reprints; originals are black steel engravings with hand or outline colour. Imprint line at foot is too small to read.
